title: Bio
mainTitle: My focus is on creating great, accessible and rich web experiences for everyone. I've been lucky enough to have been doing that for the last 15 years.
description:
I’m a Design Engineer, which means I handle both sides of the digital product process, from original UI design and wireframes all the way into production code. Instead of handing off mockups and hoping for the best, I design with technical realities in mind and code with an eye for detail.

When I’m not behind a screen, you can find me behind a mic as a radio host, catching live gigs, or diving into the world of craft beer. I also stay active at the gym and prioritize quality time with my wife and son

picture.alt: A grid collage featuring João Dias in a delightful series of escapades: beaming beside his wife like they’ve just won a lifetime supply of coffee, looking dramatically intense in the studio as if recording the next big hit, clutching a leather jacket like it’s the crown jewel of his wardrobe, basking in the countryside with the air of a man who just befriended a sheep, and broadcasting a radio show with the unmistakable confidence of someone who believes every listener is hanging on his every word.
